quote.text: The four most dangerous words in investing are: ‘this time it’s different.’
quote.author: Sir John Templeton (attributed)

stories.kicker: Iran & the Gulf · The second door slams
stories.headline: A drone shuts Saudi Arabia’s bypass, and now both of the peninsula’s oil exits are blocked at once
stories.dek: The strike that closed the East–West pipeline — the one route built to skip Hormuz — dragged Riyadh into the war directly, collapsed the Oman talks the same day, and pushed Brent to a four-month high above a hundred and eight dollars.

stories.kicker: Buy It Once · The boot, from the welt up
stories.headline: A boot is a leather upper joined to a sole — and how they are joined decides how many decades it lives
stories.dek: Learn two things — the hide and the stitch — and you can judge any boot on any shelf, cold, and see where the price stops buying wear and starts buying beauty.

stories.kicker: Down the Rabbit Hole · Modern board games
stories.headline: A fifteen-billion-dollar hobby, ranked by a single database — and it isn’t Monopoly
stories.dek: This is the post-Catan world of designer games, chosen for the name on the box and argued over on one obsessively-kept list — split between the quiet point-salad Euro and the loud dice-and-story thematic.

stories.kicker: The haze tips over · A law that has never bitten
stories.headline: The dry spell delivers: the air crosses into “unhealthy,” the cooling rooms open, and the one instrument that sounds like a remedy has still never worked
stories.dek: The twenty-four-hour index touched a hundred and forty-five by Tuesday’s small hours; a twenty-eight-agency task force has stood up its response plans and opened air-conditioned respite spaces; and the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act, invoked whenever the skies brown, has produced no successful prosecution in twelve years.

stories.kicker: The model war · The numbers, then the retreat
stories.headline: DeepSeek publishes the benchmarks, announces the old model’s retirement — and then quietly takes it back
stories.dek: V4.1 Flash cleared its scores and undercut the price by three-quarters; the plan to silently reroute the previous model’s traffic to it met a user revolt, and the retirement was withdrawn within days.

stories.kicker: Gear We’re Watching · The watch you replace every year
stories.headline: Apple’s Ultra 4 adds a day of battery and a new sensor stack for the same eight hundred dollars — and the case for sitting the year out
stories.dek: The 49-millimetre titanium flagship gains the S11 chip, a longer battery and a redesigned health-sensing system, and a new black-titanium finish; blood-pressure sensing, a microLED screen and Touch ID all failed to make the cut.

stories.kicker: Objects & Escapes · A battery you never change
stories.headline: Citizen reissues its 1973 “bullhead” for fifty years of light-powered movements — a solar chronograph with a mechanical trick
stories.dek: The Promaster Tsuno Chrono Racer marks half a century of Eco-Drive with a flyback chronograph that never needs a battery for the life of the watch — and asks you to pay for the design story, not the movement.

stories.kicker: Culture Desk · The statuettes, handed out overnight
stories.headline: “The Pitt” takes Drama for a second straight season, while Apple’s freshman “Widow’s Bay” storms Comedy on a record haul
stories.dek: The seventy-eighth Emmys, handed out in Los Angeles on Monday night, set old-guard prestige against Apple’s deep-pocketed newcomers — and both won: a medical procedural repeated at the top, and a first-year comedy swept in on the studio’s biggest-ever nomination year.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · The lowest in thirty years
stories.headline: Teen sleep hits a thirty-year low, right on the twelve-year-old band — and the reason is not, mostly, the phone
stories.dek: The largest look yet at how much American adolescents sleep finds every age group at a three-decade low, with the steepest deficit at twelve and thirteen — and the same decade of data quietly clears the smartphone of being the whole story.

stories.kicker: The Big Picture · The hike into the shock
stories.headline: An oil shock meets a Fed expected to raise into it — and gold falls as the war widens
stories.dek: Both peninsula oil routes are shut, the crude premium has become an inflation fear, and the fear has the market pricing a rate hike on Wednesday. The counter-intuitive tell is gold: it fell this week, which tells you what kind of regime this is.

stories.kicker: The Long Game · The drug that makes you move less
stories.headline: The weight comes off on a GLP-1 — and so, quietly, do the daily steps
stories.dek: A 2026 study finds people move measurably less after starting the weight-loss drugs, just when movement matters most. The muscle-melt panic that dominates the discourse, meanwhile, looks like the wrong worry — and the real fix is the same either way.

stories.kicker: What’s Worth Booking · The dated agenda
stories.headline: A Grand Prix with its first Sprint, a snowless clock ticking, and a sumo that goes on sale this weekend
stories.dek: The autumn calendar fills: book the marquees now, note the one that closes for good on the thirtieth, and be ready when the Fukuoka tickets drop on Saturday.

stories.headline: Running crew: how the country with the lowest birthrate on earth rebuilds the commons at dawn
stories.dek: The world files South Korea under “dying.” Yet ten million people now call themselves runners, gathering along the Han in loose, opt-in crews — and two backlashes this year reveal exactly what a community without obligation costs.
